reference: If the beam were weaker, he'd still be able to blink.
sk: Keby lúč bol slabší, ešte by mohol žmurkať.
cz: Kdyby paprsek byl slabší, ještě by mohl mrkat.
acceptable: If the {beam|ray} {were|was} weaker, he {would still be able to|could still} {blink|wink}.
He {would still be able to|could still} {blink|wink} if the {beam|ray} {were|was} weaker.

mistakes.text: If the beam is weaker, he would still be able to blink.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Situácia je nereálna, preto v Second Conditional patrí po „if“ „were“, nie „is“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Situace je nereálná, proto ve Second Conditional patří po „if“ „were“, ne „is“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The situation is unreal, so Second Conditional uses “were” after “if”, not “is”.

mistakes.text: If the beam would be weaker, he would still be able to blink.
mistakes.feedback_sk: V Second Conditional sa po „if“ „would“ nepíše; správne je „if the beam were“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Ve Second Conditional se po „if“ „would“ nepíše; správně je „if the beam were“.
mistakes.feedback_en: In Second Conditional don't use “would” after “if”; say “if the beam were”.

mistakes.text: If the beam were weaker, he will still be able to blink.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Nereálny následok vyjadruje „would“, nie „will“: „he would still be able to“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Nereálný následek vyjadřuje „would“, ne „will“: „he would still be able to“.
mistakes.feedback_en: An unreal result needs “would”, not “will”: “he would still be able to”.

mistakes.text: If the beam were weaker, he would still can blink.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „would“ nemôže stáť „can“; treba „would be able to“ alebo len „could“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „would“ nemůže stát „can“; je potřeba „would be able to“ nebo jen „could“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Can” can't follow “would”; use “would be able to” or simply “could”.

mistakes.text: If the beam were more weak, he would still be able to blink.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Weak“ je krátke prídavné meno, preto sa stupňuje „weaker“, nie „more weak“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Weak“ je krátké přídavné jméno, proto se stupňuje „weaker“, ne „more weak“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Weak” is a short adjective, so the comparative is “weaker”, not “more weak”.
